name: Vestige
source:
You have one hour to convince him not to kill you.

It's a particularly cold day as you visit the cemetery alone to grieve, but against all expectations, there is something there with you.  His command is simple. He gives you an hour; you give him a reason you deserve to live.

Backed into a corner, you can only think of one story to tell him— Yichen. The person you came to the cemetery for.

[From [url=https://astaysdev.itch.io/vestige]itch.io[/url]]
